// Volume / mute (host-level master gain; the position clock keeps running mute)

ly initializes the same BSP audio transport only when capture starts and reads I2S RX into a bounded 4096-sample queue; queue loss and failures are observable. Capture stop invalidates the active generation without waiting on a potentially blocking codec RX read, while power transitions use a bounded quiesce wait before codec/I2S reconfiguration. Pause/resume/stop and positions are per playback; master volume/mute is published atomically. An empty bank is valid and keeps every `play` request explicitly unavailable. Input and output use signed PCM16 little-endian, mono, 16000 Hz.
